camel_example: aliyun iot QueryDeviceProvisioning --region cn-hangzhou --ProductKey a1ji00000 --DeviceName testDevcieBwT3Un
description_en: Queries the distribution result of a specified device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定设备的分发结果
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-provisioning --product-key a1ji00000 --device-name testDevcieBwT3Un --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceProvisioning

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs
parameters.name: product_key

Code.description_en:
If the call is successful, success is returned.
If the call fails, an error code is returned. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
Code.description_zh:
调用成功时，返回success。
调用失败，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

Data.description_en: The device distribution result returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功后，返回的设备分发结果

AliyunUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account to which the device currently belongs
AliyunUid.description_zh: 设备当前所属阿里云账号

GmtCreate.description_en:
The creation time of the distribution task to which the device belongs, in milliseconds (timestamp).

If the device has not been distributed, the current server timestamp is returned
GmtCreate.description_zh:
设备所属分发任务的创建时间（毫秒级时间戳）。

如果设备未分发，则返回当前服务器时间戳

GmtModified.description_en:
The modification time of the distribution task to which the device belongs, in milliseconds (timestamp).

If the device has not been distributed, the current server timestamp is returned
GmtModified.description_zh:
设备所属分发任务的修改时间（毫秒级时间戳）。

如果设备未分发，则返回当前服务器时间戳

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

SourceIotInstanceId.description_en: The source instance ID to which the device belongs

SourceRegion.description_en: The source region to which the device belongs

TargetIotInstanceId.description_en: The target instance ID to which the device belongs

TargetRegion.description_en: The target region to which the device belongs

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
